strategic_priorities: India deterrence (Kashmir, post Operation Sindoor / May 2025 conflict)
China alignment (CPEC, ~63% of Chinese arms exports 2020-24 went to Pakistan per SIPRI)
Deepening Turkey defence ties (drones, MILGEM corvettes, T129 helicopters)
Mecca Joint Defence Agreement with Saudi Arabia and Turkey (signed 7 Aug 2026 - mutual-defence clause)
dependencies: Heavy reliance on Chinese arms imports (~63-80% of major weapons per SIPRI, varying by estimate)
Growing reliance on Turkish co-production (MILGEM corvettes, ADVENT combat systems, drones)
vulnerabilities: Reported loss of at least one Chinese-supplied HQ-9B air-defence battery during the May 2025 conflict with India (per Indian and open-source reporting; not confirmed by Pakistan)
strengths: China strategic partnership (CPEC + majority of arms imports)
New Saudi Arabia-Turkey mutual defence pact (Aug 2026)
